Hero_Desc_Kathy:
A cowardly Monatium scout who somehow found herself permanently stationed in the Ghost Swamp.
She gave herself the title 'Ghost of Terror' and reluctantly works there through her tears, counting the days until she can return to Monatium.
Album_Like_Kathy: Places where she can relax and feel at ease
Album_Hobby_Kathy: Hiding where no one can see her
Album_Wish_Kathy: To end her painful ghost act and return home
Album_Kathy1: I heard a rumor about the Ghost of Terror, a ghost so frightening that even those dreadful ghosts acknowledge it. What could it possibly be like? A ghost born from the very concept of fear sounds terrifying even to imagine.
Album_Kathy2: The ghosts practically forced me into a meeting so they could introduce the Ghost of Terror. It appeared amid an incredibly ominous atmosphere... but something was strange. Its appearance seemed artificial and its speech stiff and awkward. When I asked whether it was truly a ghost, it suddenly shrieked. The other ghosts fled, saying I had angered the Ghost of Terror... Is this really right?
Album_Kathy3: The astonishing truth is that the Ghost of Terror is an Elf. When I read her thoughts, she was trembling violently, so I calmed her and asked some questions. Her name is Kathy. She stumbled into acting like a ghost and reluctantly continued. Even after checking that no one was nearby, Kathy repeatedly begged me never to reveal the truth.
Album_Kathy4: Kathy once went missing in the Ghost Swamp. She says that even then, the other ghosts strangely avoided approaching her. Kathy finds it odd that they regard her as terrifying. Could it be because she kept shocking them with the stun gun in her hand?
Album_Kathy5: When she is not acting, Kathy is timid and easily frightened. She repeatedly complained that the agent duties assigned by City Hall did not suit her, yet she endured them. Her entire life has supposedly been a battle against fear... With someone like her posing as the Ghost of Terror, should I admire the deceiver or those being deceived?
Album_Kathy6: Because I can see inner thoughts, Kathy's struggle looks especially desperate. Her charismatic short replies come from trembling too hard to speak; her unsettling aura comes from awkward acting; and her chilling shrieks come from overwhelming nerves. Knowing all this while watching her speak with the ghosts makes me laugh helplessly... and then pity her.
Album_Kathy7: I wondered why Kathy continued this painful battle. She gave two reasons. First, she is terrified of what will happen if the ghosts discover her deception, so she must keep acting to avoid suspicion. Second... immediately after she returned safely from the Ghost Swamp, City Hall assigned her there as its resident agent. What a cruel world.
LoveHero_Kathy: I do not have to be frightened alone in the Ghost Swamp anymore, right?
LoveHeroCancel_Kathy: You are leaving me all alone in this huge, terrifying Ghost Swamp...?
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Hate1: Kathy is utterly sick of ghosts. The name alone made her wave it away, saying she would get indigestion and refusing to eat. She could at least have tasted it...
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Hate2: Saying it reminded her too much of how she acts tough while trembling inside, she clutched the air cutlet and mourned for a long time, unable to eat it.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like1: Holding up one block, she happily asked whether it resembled the standardized rectangular buildings erected throughout Monatium.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like2: Exhausted after chasing and being chased by ghosts all day, Kathy claimed she had no appetite. One spoonful of rice cake soup changed her mind, and she quickly emptied the bowl.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like3: Kathy said she must constantly watch her surroundings and move quickly, leaving no time for meals. She praised food this easy to pick up as the best possible choice.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like4: Always tense in the Ghost Swamp, she was delighted by how a cup of warm tea made her body relax.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like5: She did not know about its health benefits, but the tartness immediately sharpened her senses. With brave steps, she marched in place toward the Ghost Swamp.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like6: With chocolate cream covering her mouth, Kathy became embarrassed and wondered why exhausting days always made her crave sweets.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like7: She stuffed a huge handful into her mouth, puffed out her cheeks, and claimed walking around like this might make the ghosts fear her even more.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like8: With half-closed eyes, Kathy said the Ghost Swamp was so dark and gloomy that her body often felt as drained as it did today. At times like this, tart food was best.
Food_ChefNote_Kathy_Like9: Kathy regretted that when she hid in the cave, she had been starving and desperate for sugar. If only she had carried a few candies like these in her pocket.

LoveLetter_Kathy:
Master.

As you read this letter, do you not feel an urge to savor something eerie? Or perhaps to leave the bright, cheerful Sprite Kingdom and stroll down a gloomy, damp road... I am certain you do. Stop whatever you are doing and hurry to the Ghost Swamp! I am always waiting for you in my cave. Trembling in fear... crying... alone...
LoveCall_Kathy:
W-Whoa! Master!
H-Hello! Have you visited the Ghost Swamp recently?!
You have not? Phew~ What a relief... Huh? Why am I relieved? Ah, w-well...

Recently, while living in my Ghost Swamp cave, Imaginary Master has been appearing often.
Ah! Imaginary Master means the Master inside my imagination!
Usually my delusions take the form of Ms. Superego Id or ghosts...
but lately, you have started visiting my cave.
W-What? What did you do when you came?
Th-That... That is a secret!

A-Anyway, I wanted to confirm whether the Master I saw was really imaginary.
Next time... I hope you will actually come visit me.
Th-Then I will hang up! See you next time! Hehe...
